basis: Fixed source inspection, not a new media experiment

findings.observation: URLSessionTransport.send waits for session.data(for:) before returning body.
Status checked after send; writes buffered body to part then renames; no strict media-content or empty-file rejection.
didReceive data yields without receive cap or task cancellation.
Task handle local to start; returned interface has no cancellation handle; no onTermination binding.
Stored followRedirects is true; incoming start parameter is not assigned; callback uses stored property at line 266.
Cancellation/short transfer throws after part writes; no failure deletion.
base.send completes before checking body.count <= 100 MiB.
